place.source_title: Henry Russell House, Old Hoyt Road

brief: Storey-and-a-half Greek Revival frame house of 1850 in the Fox River mill village of Rochester: a gable-front upright with cornice returns, corner pilasters and shuttered windows, and a long side wing with a recessed porch between plain square posts; small frieze windows under the eaves, a rear lean-to and a central chimney.

floors: W . W D W W W
facade.notes: a 1.5-storey Greek Revival upright-and-wing in clapboard: a gable-front upright with corner pilasters and a cornice return, a long wing whose front is a recessed porch between pilasters; shutters throughout; a small rear ell with a pump by its door; an open snowy lawn

why.note: the upright and wing of southeast Wisconsin's Yankee settlement (1840s-50s)
the wing's porch recessed under the main roof: shade in summer, shelter from snow
